descriptionHtml:
Role: Product Owner – Commercial Lines

Experience: 10-15 Years

Location: Pune / Mumbai

Reporting To: Head – Product Delivery


Role Summary

The Product Owner – Commercial Lines will be responsible for defining and delivering Commercial Insurance capabilities across Property, Marine, Engineering, Liability, Miscellaneous, and Specialty Lines. The role will own the roadmap, product capabilities, underwriting workflows, ecosystem integrations, and technology delivery for the Commercial Lines portfolio

Key Accountabilities

• Own Commercial Lines product roadmap and delivery priorities

• Drive successful implementation of underwriting, policy administration, servicing, claims, and reinsurance capabilities

• Improve underwriting efficiency and customer experience

• Enable rapid launch of new products and broker partnerships

• Drive automation and AI-assisted underwriting initiatives


Product Ownership

• Define and manage Commercial Lines roadmap

• Prioritize business requirements, enhancements, and regulatory changes

• Own backlog management and release planning

• Define future-state commercial insurance capabilities


Business & Domain Ownership

• Partner with Underwriting, Claims, Reinsurance, Operations, and Distribution teams

• Support Property, Marine, Engineering, Liability, Miscellaneous Products, Specialty Products

• Drive optimization of underwriting and servicing workflows

• Ensure compliance with underwriting standards and regulatory requirements

Technology & Delivery Leadership

• Own delivery across PAS, Digital Channels, APIs, and ecosystem integrations

• Collaborate with Architects, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, and SI partners

• Ensure scalability, reliability, and operational readiness

• Participate in sprint planning, release governance, and production readiness reviews

Ecosystem & Partner Management

• Collaborate with:

– Brokers

– Corporate Agents

– Surveyors

– Risk Inspection Partners

– Reinsurers

– Technology Vendors

• Support onboarding of new distribution and service partners

Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

• Define underwriting and portfolio KPIs

• Drive analytics-led underwriting improvements

• Support AI-assisted risk assessment and pricing initiatives


Governance & Controls

• Manage risks, dependencies, and escalations

• Ensure compliance, audit readiness, and operational controls

• Participating in governance forums and steering committees


Required Experience

• 10–15 years of General Insurance experience

• Strong Commercial Lines expertise

• Experience in Property, Marine, Engineering, Liability, or Specialty Lines

• Experience in PAS implementation or transformation programs

• Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Commerce, or related discipline

• MBA preferred

• Insurance certifications preferred

• Agile /Product certifications preferred


Success Measures

• Product launch timelines

• Underwriting efficiency improvements

• Roadmap delivery adherence

• UAT and production quality

• Automation and STP adoption

• Stakeholder satisfaction

• Successful onboarding of brokers and ecosystem partners

descriptionHtml:
Designation: Associate Design Director: Product & AI Experiences

Location: Andheri West


We don't need another designer. We need someone who can walk into ambiguity, find the real problem, create clarity, align people around a direction, and ship products that move businesses forward. We are looking for a product leader who understands that AI is changing how products are discovered, used, and experienced. Someone who can help clients move beyond screens and workflows to create intelligent, adaptive, and AI-native experiences. If your biggest strength is making beautiful screens, this role is probably not for you. If your biggest strength is solving problems, challenging assumptions, leading people, and creating products that customers actually adopt, keep reading.


What We Believe


Technology was never the problem. Most enterprises already have plenty of it. The problem is that products are often built around systems, departments, and requirements instead of customers, behaviour, and outcomes. At BOMBAYDC, we help enterprises build intelligent digital platforms for the AI era. We work at the intersection of strategy, product thinking, design, behavioural science, and engineering. The next generation of products will not be defined by interfaces alone. They will be defined by intelligence. AI is changing how people search, decide, buy, learn, and interact with products. We believe the best product leaders will not simply design screens, they will design systems where human, business, and machine intelligence work together to create better outcomes.


The Person We Are Looking For


  • Thinks in outcomes, not deliverables.
  • Questions brief instead of blindly executing them.
  • Can translate business goals into product direction.
  • Has strong product judgement and systems thinking.
  • Can influence clients, stakeholders, and teams.
  • Raises the quality of everyone around them.
  • Uses AI as a force multiplier for thinking, research, prototyping, and execution.
  • Understands how AI is reshaping customer behaviour, products, and businesses.
  • Takes ownership, stays curious, and never stops learning.


Your Mission


You will lead some of the most important work inside the company. You will:


  • Own product strategy and experience direction for large engagements.
  • Turn ambiguous client problems into clear product opportunities.
  • Work directly with founders, enterprise CXOs, designers, and engineers.
  • Mentor teams and raise the quality of product thinking across the company.
  • Help enterprises rethink products and experiences for an AI-native future.
  • Shape intelligent experiences where AI enhances customer outcomes and business performance.
  • Drive adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes, not just design outputs.


What Success Looks Like After 12 months


  • Clients trust your judgement without needing founder intervention.
  • Designers seek your guidance because you consistently improve their work.
  • Projects become sharper, faster, and more outcome-driven.
  • You uncover product and AI opportunities others miss.
  • You become a force multiplier for both the company and our clients.

What We Do Care About


  • Product thinking.
  • Leadership.
  • Systems thinking.
  • Business understanding.
  • Communication.
  • Curiosity.
  • Craft.
  • AI fluency.
  • AI-native ways of working.


What We Don't Care About


  • Fancy process without impact.
  • UX buzzwords.
  • Portfolios that only showcase visuals.
  • Waiting for instructions.
  • Blaming clients, developers, or stakeholders.


3 Great Reasons To Work With Us


We are small but global. Our multidisciplinary team has worked in Mumbai, Barcelona, London, Stockholm, and Tokyo. Get it right, and you'll work with some of the best talent in the world. To us, people are everything. Your growth is as important to us as it is to you. While we don't have beer taps (yet!), we've created a restriction-free, high-energy environment where people can do their best work. Our larger purpose? We believe design and technology can contribute to a better life and a better India. Our ultimate goal is to harness creativity for national development while pursuing excellence in both arts and technology.


Benefits @ BOMBAYDC


  • Stay close to your family: Work for up to 2 weeks each year from your hometown if you've relocated to Mumbai.
  • Breathe easy with lesser travel: If your commute exceeds 60 minutes one way, you can work from home every Tuesday and Thursday after confirmation.
  • We protect your Grey Matter: Our HR team is always available to support, listen, and counsel whenever needed.
  • Winter Break: Enjoy an extended year-end break to spend quality time with family and recharge.
  • Extended Long Weekends: We thoughtfully design our holiday calendar to give you more opportunities to unwind.
  • Caregiver Leave: Take time off or work remotely when family members need your care during medical emergencies.
  • We Invest in You: Through learning subsidies, mentorship opportunities, and direct access to founders.
  • We Appreciate Performance: Through Project Excellence Awards and milestone celebrations throughout your journey with us.

Who This Role Is Perfect For


  • Someone who has spent years designing products and now wants a bigger canvas.
  • Someone who wants influence, ownership, and responsibility.
  • Someone who wants to help build the next generation of intelligent digital products.
  • Someone who could eventually become a Pod Head, Associate Partner, or future leader within BOMBAYDC.


Self-Test


If you read this and thought:


  • That's exactly how I think.
  • I already operate this way.
  • I want more ownership than my current role gives me.
  • I care more about solving problems


We should talk

Specialist - Product Owner - IN

The role act as liaisons between different stakeholders, including engineering, operations, and business to execute product strategy. They maintain and manage the product backlog, or the prioritized list of requirements for future product development.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

  • Incumbents in this role may also be responsible for modernization and integration efforts.
  • Product Owners work very closely with Product Managers to create user stories.
  • They author documents relating to product life cycle including product roadmap, business requirements and functional specifications.
  • They participate in sprint planning, perform market research and competitive analysis leading to the iterative development of the product.

Educational Requirements

  • University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience

  • 3+ Years Required; 5+ Years Preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level

7IC

  • Liaising with different stake holders and business users to understand the requirement/problem areas and work with development team to resolve it.
  • Good understanding of Asset management and different asset classes in capital market.
  • Create detailed documentation and flow diagrams for the requirement and proposed solutions
  • Collecting data from various sources via different processes, understand those processes.
  • Exploring and visualizing data.
  • Should be able to write SQL queries and fetch the data and review it.
  • Clearly communicating the findings from the analysis to turn information into something actionable through reports, dashboards, and/or presentations.

Key Skills Required:

  • Analyzing and translating business needs to create and propose solutions through presentations and flow diagram
  • Experience with data integration from multiple sources
  • Experience with End of day and Start of day activities on Accounting book of records
  • Must have Proficiency in at least one query language, especially SQL. (Python Preferred)
  • Must have experience in Asset management domain.
  • Understanding of Performance calculation & Analytics domain
  • Must have experience in different asset classes and their performance, attribution.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL DB is good to have.
  • Good communication skills.

Required Experience- 5-10 Years

Education- Engineering/ Masters (Finance)/CIPM/CFA/FRM or equivalent certification

Related Skills

Continuous Integration and Deployment, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Software Testing, Systems Design/Analysis, Systems Development Life Cycle

Working closely with our U.S. colleagues and other partners, our goal is to reduce risk, improve the efficiency of our technology and processes and develop innovative ideas to increase throughput and productivity.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. TIAA does not discriminate against any candidate or employee on the basis of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

We thrive in a collaborative in-office environment where teams work across organizational boundaries with shared purpose, accelerating innovation and delivering meaningful results. Our workplace brings together TIAA and Nuveen's entrepreneurial spirit, where we work hard and work together to create lasting impact. Here, every associate can grow through meaningful learning experiences and development pathways—because when our people succeed, our impact on clients' lives grows stronger.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Product Owner – Global Traditional Trade Organization

Department: GTTO / GTFO

About Business line/Function: Global Trade Operations (GTO) is an entity within CIB ITO Global Banking Operations that serves Trade Finance Operations on behalf of the Group. Its scope of intervention is global, on all sites that propose to operate Trade Finance transactions, i.e., in Domestic Core Businesses (FRB, Fortis, BGL, BNL) as in the CIB regions and International Retail Banking (IRB).

Within GTO, the Global Traditional Trade Organization team (GTTO) Act as an overall coordinator to support the global transformation on Traditional Trade Operations for GTO and its partners leveraging on extended team as one team. Thus, GTTO carries out projects around process optimization, Operating Model, and IT Assets for traditional trade products (Letters of Credit, International Guarantees).

Position Purpose: The Product Owner (PO) is the voice of the customer and the business within an Agile development environment. Working closely with cross‑functional teams (Scrum Masters, Developers, Designers, QA, Marketing, Sales, Support, etc.) the PO defines and prioritizes the product backlog, translates market and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories, and ensures that the delivered product maximizes value, aligns with the company’s strategy, and meets quality standards.

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

To deploy a common and business tool with all operational set-ups and provide our clients with Digital Banking capabilities to communicate with the bank.

To develop the product, your mission plan will consist of:

  • Develop Solid knowledge of existing systems and Business Process
  • Build documentation for User requirements / User stories
  • Maintain focus product quality throughout the development, reviewing stories, features and product increments to ensure they meet the user’s needs which are functional and compliant
  • Accountable for delivering the product in line with the business plan.
  • Defining priorities for operation’s needs & support the business requirements by Identifying and formalizing customers’ issues and needs
  • Continuous backlog management, expressing backlog items clearly in a consumable format.
  • Optimize value delivery through continuous improvement, gathering feedback from relevant stakeholders / SME and prioritization of backlog.
  • Ensure voices of the clients and stakeholders are represented.
  • Working with scrum master or project team to build an empowered high performing team

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. descriptionHtml:
The International Data Science & AI organization is committed to transforming data into actionable intelligence and scalable AI capabilities that enable markets to drive better decisions, improved customer engagement, and measurable business outcomes.

We are seeking a Sr Manager – Data Science and AI, to own the critical end‑to‑end AI for Targeting & Segmentation program for international markets, including program strategy, model design, solution, product roadmap, delivery coordination across stakeholders, and value realization. This is a senior team lead role with significant influence, requiring strong cross‑functional leadership across Data Science, Analytics, BT, ICO, Digital, and country teams to design, deploy, and scale segmentation solutions.

The successful candidate will thrive in a fast‑paced, highly collaborative environment, translate business needs into clear product/program requirements, and drive industrialization of segmentation capabilities from pilots through scalable deployments—while operating within governance, privacy, and responsible AI practices.

Role Responsibilities

AI for Segmentation Program Ownership (International)

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the AI for Targeting & Segmentation program across international markets, ensuring alignment to commercial priorities and market needs.
  • Define the program operating model, key deliverables, success measures, and cadence for planning, prioritization, and decision‑making across regions and markets.
  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for program outcomes, coordinating across functions and markets to deliver high‑quality solutions on time and with measurable impact.

Roadmap Translation, Requirements, And Delivery Coordination

  • Translate business needs into clear problem statements, requirements, and user stories for Data Science, Analytics Engineering, and Technology teams, including data needs, model requirements, workflows, and integration expectations.
  • Partner closely with Data Science and engineering teams to shape solution design, ensure feasibility, and drive progress from pilot → deployment → scaling while maintaining quality, usability, and robustness.
  • Establish and maintain program plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, and mitigations), and provide transparent updates to stakeholders across geographies and time zones.

Cross‑Functional & Market Partnership (Influence Without Authority)

  • Build strong relationships with international and local stakeholders (Commercial, Marketing, Digital, Field/Operations, Tech/IT) to align on priorities, secure input, and drive adoption.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to align on segmentation objectives, market readiness, change impacts, and enablement needs, ensuring consistent engagement and shared ownership.
  • Coordinate with centralized and regional teams to identify reusable patterns and accelerate cross‑market scaling while respecting local context, constraints, and regulatory requirements.

Adoption, Change Management, and Enablement

  • Define and execute an international adoption and change management approach, including market onboarding, training, communications, and “how to use” guidance for segmentation outputs and workflows.
  • Create and maintain program documentation and business‑facing assets (e.g., value proposition, playbooks, FAQs, release notes, training materials, and adoption metrics).
  • Incorporate feedback loops (user feedback, performance monitoring, market learnings) to continuously improve segmentation models, outputs, and end‑to‑end user experience.

Governance, Data Privacy, and Responsible AI

  • Ensure program alignment with data governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI practices, coordinating required reviews and documentation with the appropriate governance bodies.
  • Partner with Technology/IT and data teams to ensure appropriate controls for data access, model monitoring, auditability, and lifecycle management.

Value Realization, KPIs, and Performance Management

  • Define, monitor, and communicate program success metrics (e.g., adoption, business value, segmentation performance, operational efficiency), and drive actions to close performance gaps.
  • Quantify and communicate value delivered through AI for Segmentation to senior stakeholders, connecting program outcomes to measurable market impact.

Ways of Working / Agile Delivery

  • Act as “voice of the user” for international markets in agile delivery teams, helping prioritize work to maximize value and ensure usability and scalability of deliverables.
  • Promote consistent ways of working across markets (templates, standards, release cadence, and minimal viable onboarding kits) to accelerate delivery and reduce rework.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics related area (Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline)
  • 9+ years of relevant work experience delivering Analytics, Data Science, AI/ML, or Digital/Data products in a business environment, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership from problem framing to outcomes
  • 4+ years of hands-on Product Management experience
  • Demonstrated experience translating business priorities into clear requirements and roadmaps and leading delivery across cross-functional stakeholders (including influence without direct authority)
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills: ability to distill complex analytical concepts into clear, decision-oriented insights for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong program/project management skills: ability to define scope/deliverables, manage dependencies, monitor progress, and drive implementation and adoption.
  • Experience working with data and analytics ecosystems (e.g., data platforms, BI, analytics engineering) and collaborating with engineering teams to operationalize solutions.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a multi‑country, international environment, partnering across regions and time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline
  • Experience in segmentation (customer/HCP, account, or analogous segmentation), targeting, portfolio planning, or decision support, including measurement of impact and adoption.
  • Experience in product ownership and/or agile delivery practices for analytics/AI solutions, including backlog management and value-based prioritization.
  • Experience in developing Machine Learning based products, preferably with Large Language Models and GenAI solutions
  • Experience in developing and operating analytic workflows and model pipelines that are parametrized, automated and reusable
  • Experience developing and deploying data and analytic products for use by technical and non-technical audiences
  • Pharma & Life Science commercial functional knowledge
  • Pharma & Life Science commercial data literacy
  • Experience with Dataiku Data Science Studio

PROFESSIONAL CHARACTERISTICS

  • Growth Mindset: Actively seeks improvement, evaluates the impact of insights, and helps partners anticipate strategic changes.
  • Analytical Thinker: Synthesizes information across data sources into clear insights and recommendations; connects analytics to business drivers and value.
  • Strong Communicator: Translates technical outputs into actionable commentary that enables effective decisions; adapts style to audience.
  • Relationship Manager / Influencer: Builds durable partnerships across levels and functions; positively influences without formal authority.
  • Highly Collaborative: Shares responsibility and credit; works effectively across teams; supports others through knowledge sharing and teamwork.
  • Strong Program Manager: Defines scope, success criteria, and action plans; sequences work appropriately; monitors outcomes and drives adoption.
  • Proactive Self‑Starter: Comfortable with ambiguity; prioritizes competing demands; stays current on analytics/AI trends and applies them pragmatically.

Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements

Ability to work non-traditional work hours interacting with global teams spanning across the different regions (eg: North America, Europe, Asia)

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

  • Other AI and Data Science COE Teams
  • Other AIDA teams (Domain Delivery, Platforms, and Support)
  • Global Commercial Analytics

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

descriptionHtml:
Location: Hybrid / Remote

Headquarters: Matunga, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

Reports to: Director of Marketing


Overview

Testlify is seeking a Senior Content Writer who can create high-impact content that resonates with enterprise HR leaders, talent acquisition teams, and CXOs. This role is ideal for someone experienced in B2B SaaS and enterprise-focused storytelling, capable of translating complex product capabilities into clear, compelling narratives.

The ideal candidate will not only create content but also mentor and guide the junior writing team, ensuring consistent quality across all marketing assets. You will work closely with marketing, product, and leadership teams to develop thought leadership, case studies, gated assets, and strategic content that supports demand generation and brand authority.

This role requires a strong ability to write crisp, high-clarity content for thought leadership, PR, and social media, while ensuring all content aligns with Testlify’s positioning as an AI-native skills assessment platform.


Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Content Development

  • Create high-quality content tailored for enterprise audiences, including HR leaders, talent acquisition heads, and CXOs.
  • Develop case studies, customer success stories, and enterprise-focused narratives that demonstrate measurable business impact.
  • Write compelling gated assets such as whitepapers, industry reports, guides, and research-driven content.

Thought Leadership & Strategic Content

  • Work closely with leadership to create thought leadership content, including LinkedIn posts, opinion articles, and strategic insights.
  • Develop PR-ready content, contributed articles, and commentary aligned with Testlify’s brand narrative.
  • Produce clear and crisp social media content that builds brand authority and drives engagement.
  • Content Quality & Editorial Oversight
  • Review and oversee content created by junior writers, ensuring quality, accuracy, and strategic alignment.
  • Provide clear feedback, editing, and mentorship to help improve the writing capabilities of the content team.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, messaging, and storytelling across all content formats.

Content Strategy Collaboration

  • Work with SEO and marketing teams to ensure content aligns with content pillars, keyword strategies, and demand generation goals.
  • Contribute to the development of content frameworks that support enterprise marketing and product positioning.
  • Identify new content opportunities that support brand visibility, lead generation, and thought leadership.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Partner with marketing, product, and customer success teams to capture insights and convert them into compelling stories.
  • Translate product capabilities, customer success, and industry trends into engaging content assets.

Soft Skills

  • Strong storytelling and narrative-building skills
  • Ability to simplify complex ideas into clear, concise messaging
  • High editorial standards and attention to detail
  • Leadership mindset with the ability to mentor junior writers
  • Strong collaboration across marketing, product, and leadership teams

Success Metrics

  • Within 2 months, establish editorial standards and improve the quality of content produced by the writing team.
  • Within 3 months, launch high-quality enterprise-focused case studies and gated assets.
  • Within 4 months, consistently produce thought leadership content for leadership, PR, and social media channels.
  • Within 6 months, content contributes meaningfully to brand authority, organic reach, and lead generation efforts.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in content writing, preferably in B2B SaaS, HR tech, or enterprise technology.
  • Proven experience writing enterprise-focused content such as case studies, whitepapers, and thought leadership.
  • Strong editorial skills with experience reviewing and mentoring junior writers.
  • Experience creating PR, social media, and executive-level thought leadership content.
  • Ability to write clear, crisp, and persuasive content tailored for senior decision-makers.
  • Familiarity with SEO-driven content frameworks and content marketing strategies.


Reporting & Department Structure

This role reports directly to the Director of Marketing and works closely with the SEO, demand generation, and product marketing teams. The content function will play a critical role in building Testlify’s authority in the skills assessment and AI-driven hiring space.


What We Offer @ Testlify

  • Opportunity to shape the content voice of a global SaaS brand
  • Collaboration with an ambitious and fast-moving marketing team
  • Exposure to enterprise hiring ecosystems and global markets
  • Access to modern marketing and content tools
  • A culture focused on ownership, creativity, and measurable impact


Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • Diversity & Inclusion Focus
  • Learning & Growth Opportunities
  • Flexible Work Hours
  • Saturday & Sunday Week Offs
